evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.text: Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.

Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage. Leveling rows: 'Bonus True Damage' [8.4, 12, 15.6, 19.2, 22.8] + [9.2, 9.8, 10.4, 11, 11.6]% AP; 'Total Mixed Damage' [78.4, 112, 145.6, 179.2, 212.8] + [74.2, 74.8, 75.4, 76, 76.6]% AP
Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location ... dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land. Magic Damage [70, 100, 130, 160, 190] + 65% AP

Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit. Magic Damage per Sphere [80, 120, 160] + 20% AP; Minimum [240, 360, 480] + 60% AP; Maximum [560, 840, 1120] + 140% AP

Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health. NOTE: 'A sphere summoned very shortly before Unleashed Power will be used as one of the spheres that get thrown.'

Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds. Magic Damage [90, 125, 160, 195, 230] + 70% AP; rechargeRate [7, 7, 7, 7, 7]

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`) ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.

Ability rotation casts (`_schedule_shared_casts`, `_compute_ability_rotation`) | shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | EXACT | ... R single-cast. And: Ability haste (`effective_cooldown`) ... 'R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)'.

The event order shown in the UI comes from the fight's cast_order + breakdown damage_events ... setup/consume relationships (e.g. Cassiopeia Q poisons BEFORE E spam ...), cooldown gating (cast order must respect cooldowns), buffs first ... replacing the naive DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R) when a combo exists.
'Ammo / stocked charges' ... stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)

step_1_which_thresholds_are_live_at_60_s.reasoning: Splinter thresholds in the cached wiki text are 40 (Q stocks charges), 60 (W bonus true damage), 80 (E slow), 100 (R execute), 120 (+15% AP). A scenario pinned at 60 Splinters has EXACTLY the 40 and 60 bonuses live; the 80/100/120 bonuses are not.
live: Q: up to 2 stocked Dark Sphere charges (S2)

step_2_W_emits_two_damage_instances_at_6.claim: At >=60 Splinters a single Force of Will recast produces TWO damage instances -- a magic instance and a separate true-damage instance -- so it occupies two slots in a damage-event ledger.
step_2_W_emits_two_damage_instances_at_6.numeric_verification: Model the wiki sentence as true = (0.12 + 0.02*AP/100) * (base + 0.65*AP), with base = [70,100,130,160,190] (S4). Expanding: flat = 0.12*base = [8.4, 12, 15.6, 19.2, 22.8] -- exactly the cached 'Bonus True Damage' flat row (S3). Linear AP term = 0.12*65 + 0.02*base = [9.2, 9.8, 10.4, 11.0, 11.6] %AP -- exactly the cached %AP row (S3). Two independent rows reproduced to the digit, so the decomposition (and hence the separate true instance) is confirmed from the cache, not assumed. (The cache's residual 1.14 %AP row is the AP^2 term, ~0.02*0.65*100 = 1.3, not load-bearing here.)

step_3_Q_can_open_with_three_back_to_bac.claim: At >=40 Splinters Q is a stocked-charge ability (S2, S11; Q.rechargeRate = 7s, S7), max 2 stocked charges. The opener therefore admits up to 3 Dark Sphere casts in immediate succession (the ready cast plus 2 stocked charges), each a separate damage instance and each leaving a sphere on the ground for 6 s.

step_4_R_must_follow_the_sphere_setup.claim: Unleashed Power's damage is a strictly increasing function of the number of LIVE Dark Spheres at the moment of cast: 3 conjured + up to 4 grabbed (S5).
step_4_R_must_follow_the_sphere_setup.math: damage(R) = n_spheres * (per_sphere), n_spheres = 3 + min(4, live). Rank 3, AP = 400: per sphere = 160 + 0.20*400 = 240. n=3 -> 480 + 0.60*400 = 720. n=6 (3 live spheres grabbed) -> 1440. n=7 (max) -> 1120 + 1.40*400 = 1680. Each Q cast moved from AFTER R to BEFORE R therefore adds a full sphere, 80/120/160 (+20% AP) = 240 at this sample, while the Q's own damage (S7) is unchanged by the reordering.
step_4_R_must_follow_the_sphere_setup.conclusion: Ordering is not damage-neutral for Syndra: any cast order that puts a sphere-generating Q *after* R forfeits 80-160 (+20% AP) per forfeited sphere. R is a pure CONSUME step whose setup is Q (and W/E, which refresh or merely displace spheres rather than destroy them: 'Grabbing a Dark Sphere will cause the duration on it to refresh'; 'Scatter the Weak will delay the expiration of a Sphere until after it finishes being knocked back'). Under the engine's own stated rotation doctrine -- apply-before-consume, setup before payoff (S10) -- R belongs at the END of the setup prefix, not inside it.

step_5_index_arithmetic.claim: The wiki-correct 60-Splinter opener produces exactly seven leading damage instances with R in slot 6 (0-indexed).

ledger.why: Force of Will recast, magic instance (S4)
Force of Will bonus TRUE instance, live only at >=60 Splinters (S3, verified in step 2)
Scatter the Weak, single magic instance (80-Splinter slow not live at 60)
Unleashed Power, cast once per fight (S9), consuming the 3 live spheres for 3+3 = 6 sphere hits (S5)

step_5_index_arithmetic.note: R is single-cast per fight (S9) and every cast sits on one shared, greedily-ordered timeline (S8), so R appears exactly once in the ledger and its position is determined solely by where the cast order places it.

step_6_what_the_old_value_implies.reasoning: old damage_events[6].source = 'Q' with R somewhere else in the ledger. Under the naive DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R -- S10) R lands in the first cycle, i.e. before the later Q recasts; the Q sitting at index 6 is then a sphere conjured AFTER the ultimate has already barraged. That sphere contributes nothing to R (S5), which is precisely the 'unrealistic event order' the rotation layer exists to remove (S10, Cassiopeia E-before-Q example). The old ordering is therefore mechanically wrong in the direction the wiki text settles, and the new ordering (R after the Q/W/E setup prefix) is the one the cached ability text supports.

confidence.level: high on direction, medium on exact index
confidence.what_is_firmly_sourced: That Syndra's R is a consume step whose damage strictly increases with spheres placed by earlier Q casts, so a correct/optimal cast order places R AFTER the Q setup, never before a sphere-generating Q; and that at exactly 60 Splinters W contributes an extra (true-damage) event, verified digit-for-digit against the cached leveling rows.
confidence.what_could_not_be_verified: The scenario's own configuration (cast order, level, ranks, items, fight window) lives under scripts/ and tests/, which this oracle is forbidden to read, so the seven-event prefix in step 5 is a reconstruction from the cached wiki mechanics rather than a replay of the scenario. It fits the leaf exactly (R at index 6) and fits the scenario name (60 Splinters -> both the 40-charge and 60-true-damage bonuses live), but a different prefix of the same length would also put R at index 6. The verdict would flip only if the change had moved R EARLIER past a Q -- which is the opposite of what the cached mechanics reward and the opposite of the naive Q,W,E,R default the rotation layer replaces.
